text:
National Chairman of the All Progressives Congress (APC), Prof Nentawe Yilwatda, has charged governors, governorship candidates and party leaders in the North Central to unite stakeholders and mobilise support for President Bola Tinubu ahead of the 2027 presidential election.
Yilwatda gave the charge at the APC presidential campaign rally held at Azaria Road Stadium, Jos, Plateau State, where he urged party leaders to put aside personal interests and political differences to secure victory for the party.
The APC chairman expressed satisfaction with the turnout at the rally, describing it as evidence of growing unity and renewed commitment among party members in Plateau State.
He challenged the people of the state to translate the enthusiasm demonstrated at the rally into votes, insisting that Plateau must deliver a record-breaking victory for Tinubu.
Yilwatda also declared that political leaders in the state were fully united behind the President, adding that the administration had fulfilled its commitments to Plateau.
A major highlight of the rally was the presentation of APC flags to the party’s governorship candidates across the North Central region.
Yilwatda urged the Plateau State leadership to consolidate the unity within the party and mobilise support for Tinubu and other APC candidates.
In Benue, he called on Governor Hyacinth Alia and party leaders to harmonise competing interests and unite stakeholders ahead of the elections.
He expressed confidence in the Niger State leadership’s ability to use the party’s flag as a rallying point for members, while charging the Nasarawa governorship candidate and other party leaders to provide purposeful leadership and mobilise support for the President.
The APC chairman said the North Central must approach the elections with a common purpose, urging party officials, elected representatives, candidates and grassroots mobilisers to intensify engagement with voters.
“Our strength lies in our unity, our strategy is effective mobilisation, and our destination is victory. I therefore charge all our governors, governorship candidates and party leaders across the North Central to unite every stakeholder in their respective states and work together to deliver maximum votes for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu,” he said.
He added that the party would sustain its mobilisation drive and strengthen its structures across the region to secure victory for Tinubu and other APC candidates in 2027.
